Psalms 63 · Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: David seeks the Most High early; his soul thirsts and his flesh longs for Him in a dry and thirsty land where no water is.

note.label: Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: He longs to see the power and glory of the Most High as he has seen it in the sanctuary.

note.label: Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: Because the loving kindness of the Most High is better than life, David's lips shall praise Him, and he will bless Him while he lives and lift up his hands in His name.

note.label: Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: His soul shall be satisfied with marrow and fatness, and his mouth shall praise Him with joyful lips.

note.label: Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: When he remembers the Most High upon his bed and meditates on Him in the night watches, he rejoices in the shadow of His wings because He has been his help.

note.label: Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: His soul follows hard after the Most High, and His right hand upholds him.

note.label: Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: Those that seek his soul to destroy it shall go down into the lower parts of the earth; they shall fall by the sword and be a portion for foxes.

note.label: Psalm 63: Early Will I Seek Thee

points: The king shall rejoice in the Most High, and everyone that swears by Him shall glory, but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
